description: Canonical full-range DERA FSDS request plan for validating the frozen FRAME filing window 2020-01-01 through 2026-06-30 (ADR-077, ADR-084): 25 releases, 2020q1 through 2026q1, at the URL template empirically verified by canary run dera-fsds-canary-2020q1-20260816. The 2026q2 release is NOT included: it was measured unavailable - HTTP 404 at the verified template on 2026-08-16, receipted in the fail-closed run dera-fsds-full-2020q1-2026q2-20260816, which consumed the superseded 26-release plan sha256 1d03bd0843a70531498d507a80c9a73d9f26614b6459124b1efc2515d5c3aefd. FRAME absences filed after 2026-03-31 (Q2 2026) are classified right_boundary_unobserved, never noncoverage, until a successor plan adds 2026q2 after DERA publishes it. Possessing this plan does not authorize a live request; the full acquisition remains separately authorized. DERA is an independent FRAME validation source only, never eligibility or universe input (ADR-081).
observed_through_basis: Last-available-release-quarter-end basis: the newest available FSDS release is 2026q1, covering filings accepted through 2026-03-31. Measured evidence: 2026q2 returned HTTP 404 at the verified template on 2026-08-16 (failure receipt in run dera-fsds-full-2020q1-2026q2-20260816; superseded 26-release plan sha256 1d03bd0843a70531498d507a80c9a73d9f26614b6459124b1efc2515d5c3aefd). Consequently every FRAME absence filed after 2026-03-31 is right_boundary_unobserved, never FSDS/XBRL noncoverage (ADR-081 boundary rule). A successor plan restores observed_through 2026-06-30 under the acceptance-rule basis and adds 2026q2 once DERA publishes it (ADR-084).
